attempts.summary: On node1 (RHEL 10), built a local RPM repository from local storage (/srv/local-repo, populated via createrepo_c), served it over HTTP on NODE_IP:8080, disabled the remote RHEL CDN repos and blocked cdn.redhat.com via /etc/hosts to simulate the remote repos being unreachable, then installed the `tree` package purely from the local repo. Verified installation success and functionality, restored remote reachability and repo config, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured boot_id baseline, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified the installed package, local repo files, and repo configuration all persisted post-restart.
